passage.label: Most Merciful taught Quran created man taught eloquence; sun moon precise calculation stars trees prostrate; heaven raised imposed balance not transgress balance establish weight justice not deficient balance; earth laid out creatures fruit palm trees sheaths grain husks scented plants which favors deny; created man clay pottery jinn smokeless flame fire which favors deny; Lord two sunrises two sunsets which favors deny; released two seas meeting barrier neither transgresses which favors deny; both emerge pearl coral which favors deny; ships elevated sea mountains which favors deny; everyone earth perish remain Face Lord Owner Majesty Honor which favors deny; whoever heavens earth asks Him every day bringing matter which favors deny

arabicExcerpts.text: وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلۡوَزۡنَ بِٱلۡقِسۡطِ وَلَا تُخۡسِرُواْ ٱلۡمِيزَانَ
وَخَلَقَ ٱلۡجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٖ مِّن نَّارٖ
وَلَهُ ٱلۡجَوَارِ ٱلۡمُنشَـَٔاتُ فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ كَٱلۡأَعۡلَٰمِ
وَيَبۡقَىٰ وَجۡهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلۡجَلَٰلِ وَٱلۡإِكۡرَامِ
يَسۡـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ كُلَّ يَوۡمٍ هُوَ فِي شَأۡنٖ

mainSubject.label: The Most Merciful named as teacher of the Quran, creator of man and giver of eloquence; sun and moon moving by precise calculation while stars and trees prostrate; the heaven raised with the balance imposed, commanding no transgression in weighing and just establishment of measure; the earth laid out for creatures bearing fruit, sheathed palms, husked grain and scented plants; man created from pottery-like clay and jinn from smokeless flame; lordship of the two sunrises and two sunsets; the two seas released to meet behind a barrier neither transgresses, yielding pearl and coral; mountain-like elevated ships belonging to Him; universal perishing of all on earth while the Face of the Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honour, remains; every being in heavens and earth asking Him while He brings about a matter each day — each unit closed by the refrain challenging denial of the Lord's favours

notes: Wave 9 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the eighth refrain after daily disposal (30) before the thaqalan address opens (31); P2 ends with the fifteenth refrain after the Hell-hamim circulation (45); P3 covers the first garden pair through the good-for-good principle and its refrain (46-61); P4 covers the second garden pair through the closing blessing on the divine name (62-78). The 31 occurrences of the favours-denial refrain are labelled individually with their preceding subject so no subordinate label repeats.
